responsibility: This hand-written target option description file declares the m68k backend’s command-line switches and option variables. It defines aliases and parsing metadata for CPU, ISA, and tuning selectors such as -mcpu=, -march=, and -mtune=, as well as feature toggles for bitfields, hard/soft float, RTD calling convention, PIC variants, ColdFire hardware divide, TLS/GOT size support, and related ABI/code-generation behaviors. GCC’s option machinery uses it together with m68k-tables.opt to turn user options into backend state consumed by m68k.cc and the machine descriptions.
same_name_distinction: Defines the m68k stem's target option table: mcpu=/march=/mtune= selectors, feature masks, aliases, and option variables that GCC's option machinery turns into backend state. Unlike m68k.cc it does not implement behavior, unlike m68k.h it is not the target macro/configuration header, and unlike m68k.md it does not describe RTL instruction patterns.
